entry.title: Dirt Bike Rider Fatally Injured, Teen Hurt In Oregon Dunes Crash Near Railroad Hill
entry.summary: A 35-year-old dirt bike rider was fatally injured and a 13-year-old rider was seriously hurt Sunday in an Oregon Dunes crash near Railroad Hill. Officials said speed and jumping without a spotter were contributing factors.

entry.title: Federal Officials Warn EMS Agencies About Emerging Synthetic Opioid Threat
entry.summary: Federal officials are warning EMS agencies and clinicians about cychlorphine, an emerging synthetic opioid linked to at least 55 deaths nationwide and described as potentially far more potent than fentanyl.

entry.title: RV Fire In Dillard Damages Utility Lines, Spreads To Nearby Trees
entry.summary: Central Douglas Fire & Rescue crews responded Sunday to a fully involved camp trailer fire on Cobb Street in Dillard. The fire spread to nearby trees and damaged overhead utility lines. No injuries were reported.
